summaries.title: Infinite-LLM: Efficient LLM Service for Long Context with DistAttention and Distributed KVCache
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**高效推理与系统**（Efficiency & Sys）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限、长程上下文建模与远距历史记忆衰减」痛点，作者围绕 **Infinite-LLM** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、键值缓存（KV Cache）。核心论点主张：Based on that, we propose DistKV-LLM, a distributed LLM serving system that dynamically manages KV Cache and effectively orchestrates all accessible GPU and CPU memories...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **A100**。实验设计与验证细节：Validated in a cloud environment with 32 NVIDIA A100 GPUs in configurations from 2 to 32 instances, our system exhibited 1.03-2.4x end-to-end throughput...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **2.4x, 19x**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Validated in a cloud environment with 32 NVIDIA A100 GPUs in configurations from 2 to 32 instances, our system exhibited 1.03-2.4x end-to-end throughput improvements and supported...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 17 赞），本工作为突破 **KV缓存压缩与推测解码 (KV & Speculative)** 中的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
